name: Citation checks
summary: Ask whether a cited source actually supports the claim it is attached to.

input.state: The claim, then the cited passage it is claimed to support.

supported.instructions: The passage supports the claim as stated - not merely the same topic.
supported.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

cost.bound: one judgment per claim-source pair; multi-source claims are one pair each

uncertainty.abstain: an ambiguous passage answers unsupported - the claim needs a better citation, not a pass
uncertainty.refusal: a refused pair reports refused and stays flagged for human review

limits: Checks support, not truth - a true claim with a wrong citation is unsupported.
The passage is supplied by the caller; the recipe does not fetch the source.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
